world.title: 单粒子逐个穿过双缝形成干涉条纹
world.posterTitle: 一颗粒子会和「自己」发生干涉吗？
world.posterHook: 先看波的叠加，再逐个发射粒子累积条纹；打开「观测路径」，亲手让干涉当场消失。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 波场模拟 + 蒙特卡洛 · 本地构建
world.question: 为什么单个粒子也会形成干涉条纹？
world.hook: 调节波长与缝距验证 Δx=λL/d，再切到逐个粒子模式看概率波浮现；打开路径观测，条纹立刻消失。
world.payoff: 干涉来自概率幅叠加：即使一次只发射一个粒子，落点分布仍服从波的干涉图样；一旦获取「走了哪条缝」的信息，量子叠加被破坏，条纹消失。

en.title: Single particles build an interference pattern at a double slit
en.posterHook: First watch the superposition of waves, then launch particles one by one to accumulate stripes; open the "observation path" and make the interference disappear on the spot.
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Wave field simulation + Monte Carlo · Local construction
en.question: Why do single particles also form interference fringes?
en.hook: Adjust the wavelength and slit distance to verify Δx=λL/d, then switch to the particle-by-particle mode to see the probability wave emerge; open the path for observation, and the stripes disappear immediately.
en.payoff: Interference comes from probability amplitude superposition: even if only one particle is emitted at a time, the impact point distribution still obeys the interference pattern of the wave; once the information of "which slit has been taken" is obtained, the quantum superposition is destroyed and the stripes disappear.
